COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
CRLR No. 228 of 2026
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Ms. Khushboo Tiwari Sharma, learned
counsel for the revisionist.
2. Mr. B.C. Joshi, learned AGA for the
State.
3. Ms. Ridhima Goel and Mr. Saif Uddin
Khan, learned counsel for the complainant.
4. The instant revision has been preferred
against the order of the Principal Judge, Family
Court, Haldwani, rejecting the application for
grant of interim maintenance.
5. Both the parties are present and they are
directed to appear before the Counsellor today
itself, then, post this matter on 30.04.2026
immediately after fresh.
6. In the meantime, both the parties are
restrained from pursuing any proceeding
pending before any court.
7. The respondent shall transfer Rs.
20,000/- today itself as a travelling allowance in
the account of the revisionist.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 24.04.2026
SKS / Nahid
